turns.question: What was our best week between Monday 17 August and Sunday 27 September 2026, and what did it bring in?
turns.answer: Our best week was Monday 21 to Sunday 27 September 2026, with revenue of EUR 3,387.25 (non-cancelled orders), the highest of the six weeks from 17 August to 27 September 2026. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
